labels.not assessed: x_earth, x_ref or tau is null

tau_reason.moon/thermal_swing_K: Setting tau to the lunar swing itself makes the score the share of the Moon's swing that a site reproduces, so 0 means no swing and 1 means the full lunar swing.
tau_reason.moon/slope_deg: The spread of median slope across our three measured Earth sites shows how much this number naturally varies between Earth analogs, so a site that differs from the Malapert reference by more than that spread counts as no match.
tau_reason.moon/roughness_m: Tau is the Moon's own median roughness, so a gap as large as the Moon's own roughness counts as no match; the spread of only three sites (0.06 m) was too close to the 0.01 m rounding of the data to use.
tau_reason.mars/mean_temperature_K: The spread of mean temperature across our five Earth sites shows how much this number naturally varies between Earth analogs, so a site that differs from Mars by more than that spread counts as no match.
